text: RESULTS: MRCP demonstrates significant dilation of the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts with an abrupt cutoff in the distal common bile duct, suggestive of an obstructing mass at the head of the pancreas.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRCP findings of an abrupt cutoff in the distal common bile duct with upstream dilation are highly suggestive of pancreatic adenocarcinoma. To confirm the diagnosis and obtain tissue for staging, I will proceed with a biopsy. REQUEST TEST: Endoscopic_Ultrasound_with_Biopsy

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal EUS biopsy is puzzling given the clear obstruction on MRCP, so I need to rule out other causes of distal CBD obstruction like cholangiocarcinoma or ampullary tumors. REQUEST TEST: CA_19_9

speaker: Doctor
text: The markedly elevated CA 19-9 level, combined with the MRCP findings and classic symptoms, strongly confirms pancreatic adenocarcinoma despite the non-diagnostic biopsy. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma
